run_eval_retrieval_cli: run the eval_retrieval CLI to compute retrieval metrics comparing a guess KILT file against a gold KILT file
evaluate_retrieval_metrics: evaluate retrieval metrics for a KILT dataset by comparing guess and gold files with configurable k values
compute_ranking_metrics: compute precision, recall, success rate, and R-precision metrics for a single KILT datapoint across multiple k values
get_rank_evidence_sets: get the rank vector for a guess item against gold evidence sets treating each evidence set as a single point
compute_rprecision: compute R-precision for a guess item by measuring how many gold IDs appear in the top R predictions
